{{Short description|None}}

[[File:Turnerinnen der niederländischen Goldriege von 1928.jpg|thumb|Gold medal-winning Dutch team at the [[Gymnastics at the 1928 Summer Olympics|1928 Olympic Games]]]]
[[Gymnastics]] events have been staged at the [[Olympic Games]] since 1896, with women competing for the time at the [[Gymnastics at the 1928 Summer Olympics|1928 Olympic Games]],<ref>Gutman, Dan (1996). ''[https://books.google.com/books?id=UsnUxfFEQxUC Gymnastics]''. Puffin Books. p. 8.</ref>  where the team from the Netherlands won gold.<ref>{{cite web|url=https://olympics.com/en/olympic-games/amsterdam-1928/results/gymnastics-artistic/team-competition-women|title=Amsterdam 1928: Gymnastics Artistic Team Competition Women Results|work=[[International Olympic Committee]]}}</ref>
